Overview

[/b]Do you pride yourself on your fishing skills? [b]Perfect Catch Streak[/b] rewards your precision by tracking consecutive perfect catches. The higher your streak, the more bonus Fishing XP you earn! One mistake (or a lost fish) and the streak resets. Can you beat your all-time high score?


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40722/40722-1767236709-1198723927.png[/img]﻿[/center]


[b]Features

[/b][list]
[*][b]Streak Counter:[/b] Every "Perfect" catch increases your current streak.
[*][b]Scaling XP Bonus:[/b] Earn a base XP bonus plus additional XP for every level of your streak.
[*][b]Record Tracking:[/b] The mod automatically saves your [b]All-Time Best Streak[/b] to the config file.
[*][b]HUD Notifications:[/b] Real-time updates in the bottom-left corner showing your current streak and XP gains.
[*][b]Stardew 1.6 Ready:[/b] Built specifically for the latest version of Stardew Valley.
[/list]
[b][color=#00ff00]1.1 Update added
[/color][/b]
[*][b]Treasure Bonus:[/b] Successfully capturing a treasure chest now secures your streak even if the fish catch itself was not perfect.

[*][b]Flexible Progression:[/b] If you choose to ignore or miss a treasure, your streak will still continue as long as you land the fish with a perfect rating.



[center][youtube]rSwA1ax6j6Y[/youtube][/center][b]How it Works

[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Start Fishing:[/b] Catch any fish.

[*][b]Stay Perfect:[/b] If the "Perfect!" text appears at the end of the minigame, your streak increases.

[*][b]Earn Rewards:[/b] You will receive a notification and a bonus to your Fishing skill XP.

[*][b]Don't Slip Up:[/b] If you catch a fish but it wasn't perfect, or if the fish gets away, your streak resets to zero.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40722/40722-1767236549-441009649.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/list][line][b]How to Configure Your Mod
[/b]
After running the game once with the mod installed, a [code]config.json[/code] file will be created inside the [code]Mods/PerfectCatchStreak[/code] folder. You can open this file with any text editor (like Notepad) to change how the mod behaves.

[b]The Config Settings Explained

[/b][b]Step-by-Step Editing

[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Locate the file:[/b] Go to [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/PerfectCatchStreak/config.json[/code].

[*][b]Open it:[/b] Right-click the file and select [b]Open With > Notepad[/b].

[*][b]Edit the values:[/b] Change the numbers or "true/false" words.
[list]
[*][i]Example:[/i] To get way more XP, change [code]"XPPerStreakLevel": 2[/code] to [code]"XPPerStreakLevel": 10[/code].
[/list]
[*][b]Save:[/b] Press [code]Ctrl + S[/code] and restart your game.


[b][/b][/list]
[b]Compatibility

[/b][list]
[*][b]Custom Fish & Maps:[/b] Fully compatible with mods like [i]More New Fish[/i] or [i]Ridgeside Village[/i] as it works with any fishing minigame.
[*][b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b] Works alongside "Easy Fishing" or UI mods that change the look or size of the fishing bar.
[*][b]XP & Skill Mods:[/b] Safely adds bonus XP to your fishing skill, making it compatible with skill overhauls and prestige mods.
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Individual-based; each player tracks their own personal streak and high score.
[/list]
